name: Dal Makhani with Jeera Rice

components.name: Dal Makhani

ingredients.name: Dry whole black urad dal, washed and soaked overnight
Dry red kidney beans, soak and cook thoroughly
Fresh water for boiling legumes after soaking

steps: Soak urad dal and DRIED kidney beans separately overnight, drain soaking water and rinse. Cook kidney beans in freshly boiling water until fully tender; never use slow low-temperature cooking for raw kidney beans.

Simmer both fully cooked legumes together with fresh water as needed until the urad softens and begins to break apart; this can take 1-2 hours in an ordinary pot, significantly longer than pressure cooking.
In a second pan soften onion in half the butter with garlic and ginger; cook tomato puree and garam masala until concentrated.
Add the tomato base to the tender dal and keep on very low heat 30-45 minutes, stirring to prevent scorching. Finish with remaining butter, cream and salt.
Pack 5 portions of dal and rice. Expect lentils to firm considerably in the fridge; add water when reheating.

components.name: Cumin Rice
steps: Cook rice in measured water and mix with cumin seeds lightly toasted in oil.

Cool cooked rice rapidly and keep refrigerated; avoid leaving rice at room temperature. Reheat rice thoroughly once.
